episode_title: Trump-Xi-Putin Meeting, Nvidia Board Rejects Haung's Return, Computer System Outages
script_en: Trump-Xi-Putin Meeting, Nvidia Board Rejects Haung's Return, Computer System Outages.

President Trump meets Xi Jinping in China as the two countries remain locked in disputes over trade, rare earths and advanced technology, before Vladimir Putin joins them for a three-way summit aimed partly at projecting global leadership.

Nvidia's board says Jensen Huang will not return as CEO, even as the company posts another huge quarter and its interim leadership tries to reassure investors that the chipmaker can stay on top without its founder.
Apple, the National Security Agency, the FAA and major banks have all suffered recent computer outages, raising questions about why so many critical systems are breaking down at once.
